HUB v3.0.6 for Windows

Windows Stable package: HUB-v3.0.6-release.zip.

What's new

- Sequence Browser: rebuilt card rendering for large galleries. Only nearby rows are drawn using a reusable canvas pool, and visible previews load first. Cached images, live refresh, recent/Base highlights and PNG/JPG/WebP shortcuts are retained.
- Font filters: turn off Include fonts to hide detected font bundles. Choose All fonts, EN + TH, EN only or TH only to narrow the font languages while keeping regular artwork visible. Detection is shared with Font PSD. Your choice is saved; hidden previews are not loaded.
- Curve Repair: optional Target size curve fitting can reduce generated bone keys further while respecting your Maximum change setting. Preview and Export use the same settings. Existing optimization presets remain available; Safe stays the default.
- Size-target safety: oversized results now require confirmation before saving, including batch exports. The result reports missed targets and the space needed by untouched data. A requested size is not guaranteed, and HUB will not silently loosen accuracy to reach it.
- Selected animations: clearer Animations to change selection lets you smooth only what needs it. Unselected animation data remains unchanged. Per-animation settings choose smoothing styles; they do not select animations to process.

Target size is approximate. Compare the final animation in Preview and verify playback and mixing in the game's runtime. Maximum change measures local transform differences, not screen pixels. Unchanged skeleton data can make a small size target impossible. Input files are not overwritten, and optimization is not a Spine version converter.

Font filtering recognizes localized bundle families, not text inside images. Unusual unlocalized font folders may remain visible.

Automatic Spine conversion remains disabled. Export compatible legacy JSON from Spine before normal CC packing. Asset Stage and Audio Volume Match remain beta-only and are not included. Windows only; no macOS release change.

Update inside HUB: Updates > Stable > Check now > Download update > Install & restart. Existing updater-enabled versions can update directly; intermediate Beta versions are not required. Settings and history are preserved. Installation needs confirmation and cannot start while an editing job is running. Automatic notifications remain Stable-only; Beta checks are manual.

For a fresh installation, extract HUB-v3.0.6-release.zip and run HUB/HUB.exe. Keep the complete HUB folder together.
